title: Every architecture of six two-qubit gates is locally universal on three qubits
summary: We present the \emph{first} analytical determination of the exact accessible dimension for every fixed architecture of arbitrary two-qubit gates on three qubits. A support word represents which pair of qubits each two-qubit gate acts on, and its reduced length is obtained by merging consecutive gates on the same pair. If the reduced length is $r$, then the set of implementable three-qubit unitaries has accessible dimension $d(w)=\min\{63,9r+9\}$.
